verses.original: Τί οὖν τὸ περισσὸν τοῦ Ἰουδαίου ἢ τίς ἡ ὠφέλεια τῆς περιτομῆς
verses.transliteration: Ti oun to perisson tou Ioudaiou ē tis hē ōpheleia tēs peritomēs
verses.literal: What then is the advantage of being a Jew Or what is the value of circumcision
verses.literalPt: Que vantagem, pois, tem o judeu? Ou qual é a utilidade da circuncisão?

verses.original: πολὺ κατὰ πάντα τρόπον πρῶτον μὲν γὰρ ὅτι ἐπιστεύθησαν τὰ λόγια τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: poly kata panta tropon prōton men gar hoti episteuthēsan ta logia tou Theou
verses.literal: Much in every way First of all they have been entrusted with the very words of God
verses.literalPt: Muita, de toda maneira. Principalmente porque, na verdade, lhes foram confiados os oráculos de Deus.

verses.original: Τί γάρ εἰ ἠπίστησάν τινες μὴ ἡ ἀπιστία αὐτῶν τὴν πίστιν τοῦ Θεοῦ καταργήσει
verses.transliteration: Ti gar ei ēpistēsan tines mē hē apistia autōn tēn pistin tou Theou katargēsei
verses.literal: What if some did not have faith Will their lack of faith nullify God’s faithfulness
verses.literalPt: Que será, pois? Se alguns não tiveram fé, porventura, a sua falta de fé anulará a fidelidade de Deus?

verses.original: μὴ γένοιτο γινέσθω δὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἀληθής πᾶς δὲ ἄνθρωπος ψεύστης καθὼς γέγραπται Ὅπως ἂν δικαιωθῇς ἐν τοῖς λόγοις σου καὶ νικήσεις ἐν τῷ κρίνεσθαί σε
verses.transliteration: mē genoito ginesthō de ho Theos alēthēs pas de anthrōpos pseustēs kathōs gegraptai Hopōs an dikaiōthēs en tois logois sou kai nikēseis en tō krinesthai se
verses.literal: Certainly not - Let God be true and every man a liar As it is written So that You may be proved right when You speak and victorious when You judge
verses.literalPt: De modo nenhum! Antes, Deus seja achado verdadeiro, e todo homem, mentiroso, como está escrito: Para que sejas justificado nas tuas palavras e venças quando fores julgado.

verses.original: Εἰ δὲ ἡ ἀδικία ἡμῶν Θεοῦ δικαιοσύνην συνίστησιν τί ἐροῦμεν μὴ ἄδικος ὁ Θεὸς ὁ ἐπιφέρων τὴν ὀργήν κατὰ ἄνθρωπον λέγω
verses.transliteration: Ei de hē adikia hēmōn Theou dikaiosynēn synistēsin ti eroumen mē adikos ho Theos ho epipherōn tēn orgēn kata anthrōpon legō
verses.literal: But if our unrighteousness highlights the righteousness of God what shall we say That God is unjust to inflict His wrath on us I am speaking in human terms
verses.literalPt: Mas, se a nossa injustiça prova a justiça de Deus, que diremos? Acaso, Deus, que castiga com ira, é injusto? (Falo como homem.)

verses.original: μὴ γένοιτο ἐπεὶ πῶς κρινεῖ ὁ Θεὸς τὸν κόσμον
verses.transliteration: mē genoito epei pōs krinei ho Theos ton kosmon
verses.literal: Certainly not In that case how could God judge the world
verses.literalPt: De modo nenhum! Porque, então, como julgará Deus ao mundo?

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ἡ ἀλήθεια τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν τῷ ἐμῷ ψεύσματι ἐπερίσσευσεν εἰς τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ τί ἔτι κἀγὼ ὡς ἁμαρτωλὸς κρίνομαι
verses.transliteration: ei de hē alētheia tou Theou en tō emō pseusmati eperisseusen eis tēn doxan autou ti eti kagō hōs hamartōlos krinomai
verses.literal: However if - my falsehood accentuates God’s truthfulness to the increase of His glory why am I still condemned as a sinner
verses.literalPt: Mas, se a verdade de Deus, por minha mentira, abundou para a sua glória, por que razão sou eu também ainda julgado como pecador?

verses.original: καὶ μὴ καθὼς βλασφημούμεθα καὶ καθώς φασίν τινες ἡμᾶς λέγειν ὅτι Ποιήσωμεν τὰ κακὰ ἵνα ἔλθῃ τὰ ἀγαθά ὧν τὸ κρίμα ἔνδικόν ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: kai mē kathōs blasphēmoumetha kai kathōs phasin tines hēmas legein hoti Poiēsōmen ta kaka hina elthē ta agatha hōn to krima endikon estin
verses.literal: Why not say as some slanderously claim that we say Let us do evil that good may result Their condemnation is deserved
verses.literalPt: E por que não (como somos caluniados e como alguns afirmam que nós dizemos): Façamos males para que venham bens? A condenação dos quais é justa.

verses.original: Τί οὖν προεχόμεθα οὐ πάντως προῃτιασάμεθα γὰρ Ἰουδαίους τε καὶ Ἕλληνας πάντας ὑφ’ ἁμαρτίαν εἶναι
verses.transliteration: Ti oun proechometha ou pantōs proētiasametha gar Ioudaious te kai Hellēnas pantas hyph’ hamartian einai
verses.literal: What then Are we any better Not at all For we have already made the charge that Jews and Greeks alike are all under sin
verses.literalPt: Que pois? Somos melhores que eles? De nenhuma sorte! Porque já temos acusado tanto judeus como gregos de estarem todos debaixo do pecado,

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται ὅτι Οὐκ ἔστιν δίκαιος οὐδὲ εἷς
verses.transliteration: kathōs gegraptai hoti Ouk estin dikaios oude heis
verses.literal: As it is written There is no one righteous not even one
verses.literalPt: como está escrito: Não há nenhum justo, nem sequer um,

verses.original: οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ συνίων οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἐκζητῶν τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: ouk estin ho syniōn ouk estin ho ekzētōn ton Theon
verses.literal: There is no one who understands no one who seeks God
verses.literalPt: não há quem entenda, não há quem busque a Deus;

verses.original: πάντες ἐξέκλιναν ἅμα ἠχρεώθησαν οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ποιῶν χρηστότητα οὐκ ἔστιν ἕως ἑνός
verses.transliteration: pantes exeklinan hama ēchreōthēsan ouk estin ho poiōn chrēstotēta ouk estin heōs henos
verses.literal: All have turned away they have together become worthless there is no one who does good not even one
verses.literalPt: todos se extraviaram, à uma se fizeram inúteis; não há quem faça o bem, não há nem sequer um.

verses.original: τάφος ἀνεῳγμένος ὁ λάρυγξ αὐτῶν ταῖς γλώσσαις αὐτῶν ἐδολιοῦσαν ἰὸς ἀσπίδων ὑπὸ τὰ χείλη αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: taphos aneōgmenos ho larynx autōn tais glōssais autōn edoliousan ios aspidōn hypo ta cheilē autōn
verses.literal: Their throats are open graves their tongues practice deceit The venom of vipers is on their lips
verses.literalPt: A garganta deles é um sepulcro aberto; com as suas línguas, usam de dolo, veneno de áspides está debaixo dos seus lábios;

verses.original: ὧν τὸ στόμα ἀρᾶς καὶ πικρίας γέμει
verses.transliteration: hōn to stoma aras kai pikrias gemei
verses.literal: Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness
verses.literalPt: a sua boca está cheia de maldição e de amargura;

verses.original: ὀξεῖς οἱ πόδες αὐτῶν ἐκχέαι αἷμα
verses.transliteration: oxeis hoi podes autōn ekcheai haima
verses.literal: Their feet are swift to shed blood
verses.literalPt: os seus pés são velozes para derramar sangue;

verses.original: σύντριμμα καὶ ταλαιπωρία ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: syntrimma kai talaipōria en tais hodois autōn
verses.literal: ruin and misery lie in their wake
verses.literalPt: há destruição e miséria nos seus caminhos;

verses.original: καὶ ὁδὸν εἰρήνης οὐκ ἔγνωσαν
verses.transliteration: kai hodon eirēnēs ouk egnōsan
verses.literal: and the way of peace they have not known
verses.literalPt: não têm conhecido o caminho da paz.

verses.original: οὐκ ἔστιν φόβος Θεοῦ ἀπέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: ouk estin phobos Theou apenanti tōn ophthalmōn autōn
verses.literal: There is no fear of God before their eyes
verses.literalPt: Não há temor de Deus diante de seus olhos.

verses.original: Οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι ὅσα ὁ νόμος λέγει τοῖς ἐν τῷ νόμῳ λαλεῖ ἵνα πᾶν στόμα φραγῇ καὶ ὑπόδικος γένηται πᾶς ὁ κόσμος τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: Oidamen de hoti hosa ho nomos legei tois en tō nomō lalei hina pan stoma phragē kai hypodikos genētai pas ho kosmos tō Theō
verses.literal: Now we know that whatever the law says it says to those who are under the law so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world held accountable to God
verses.literalPt: Ora, sabemos que tudo o que a Lei diz, aos que estão debaixo da Lei o diz, para que toda boca fique fechada, e todo o mundo esteja sob o juízo de Deus;

verses.original: διότι ἐξ ἔργων νόμου οὐ δικαιωθήσεται πᾶσα σὰρξ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ διὰ γὰρ νόμου ἐπίγνωσις ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: dioti ex ergōn nomou ou dikaiōthēsetai pasa sarx enōpion autou dia gar nomou epignōsis hamartias
verses.literal: Therefore no one . . . will be justified in His sight . . . by works of the law For the law merely brings awareness of sin
verses.literalPt: porquanto por obras da lei nenhum homem será justificado diante dele, pois, pela lei, vem o pleno conhecimento do pecado.

verses.original: Νυνὶ δὲ χωρὶς νόμου δικαιοσύνη Θεοῦ πεφανέρωται μαρτυρουμένη ὑπὸ τοῦ νόμου καὶ τῶν προφητῶν
verses.transliteration: Nyni de chōris nomou dikaiosynē Theou pephanerōtai martyroumenē hypo tou nomou kai tōn prophētōn
verses.literal: But now apart from the law the righteousness of God has been revealed as attested by the Law and the Prophets
verses.literalPt: Mas, agora, sem lei, tem-se manifestado a justiça de Deus, atestada pela Lei e pelos profetas,

verses.original: δικαιοσύνη δὲ Θεοῦ διὰ πίστεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς πάντας τοὺς πιστεύοντας οὐ γάρ ἐστιν διαστολή
verses.transliteration: dikaiosynē de Theou dia pisteōs Iēsou Christou eis pantas tous pisteuontas ou gar estin diastolē
verses.literal: And this righteousness from God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe There is no distinction
verses.literalPt: a saber, a justiça de Deus mediante a fé em Jesus Cristo, para com todos os que creem. Pois não há distinção,

verses.original: πάντες γὰρ ἥμαρτον καὶ ὑστεροῦνται τῆς δόξης τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: pantes gar hēmarton kai hysterountai tēs doxēs tou Theou
verses.literal: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God
verses.literalPt: porque todos pecaram e necessitam da glória de Deus,

verses.original: δικαιούμενοι δωρεὰν τῇ αὐτοῦ χάριτι διὰ τῆς ἀπολυτρώσεως τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: dikaioumenoi dōrean tē autou chariti dia tēs apolytrōseōs tēs en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: and are justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: sendo justificados gratuitamente pela sua graça, mediante a redenção que há em Cristo Jesus;

verses.original: ὃν προέθετο ὁ Θεὸς ἱλαστήριον διὰ τῆς πίστεως ἐν τῷ αὐτοῦ αἵματι εἰς ἔνδειξιν τῆς δικαιοσύνης αὐτοῦ διὰ τὴν πάρεσιν τῶν προγεγονότων ἁμαρτημάτων ἐν τῇ ἀνοχῇ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hon proetheto ho Theos hilastērion dia tēs pisteōs en tō autou haimati eis endeixin tēs dikaiosynēs autou dia tēn paresin tōn progegonotōn hamartēmatōn en tē anochē tou Theou
verses.literal: God presented Him as an atoning sacrifice in His blood through faith in order to demonstrate His righteousness because in His forbearance He had passed over the sins committed beforehand
verses.literalPt: ao qual Deus propôs como propiciação, pela fé, no seu sangue, para manifestar a sua justiça por ter deixado de lado os delitos passados na tolerância de Deus,

verses.original: πρὸς τὴν ἔνδειξιν τῆς δικαιοσύνης αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ νῦν καιρῷ εἰς τὸ εἶναι αὐτὸν δίκαιον καὶ δικαιοῦντα τὸν ἐκ πίστεως Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: pros tēn endeixin tēs dikaiosynēs autou en tō nyn kairō eis to einai auton dikaion kai dikaiounta ton ek pisteōs Iēsou
verses.literal: He did this to demonstrate His righteousness at the present time so as - to be just and to justify the one who has faith in Jesus
verses.literalPt: tendo em vista a manifestação da sua justiça no tempo presente, a fim de que ele mesmo seja justo e justificador daquele que tem fé em Jesus.

verses.original: Ποῦ οὖν ἡ καύχησις ἐξεκλείσθη διὰ ποίου νόμου τῶν ἔργων οὐχί ἀλλὰ διὰ νόμου πίστεως
verses.transliteration: Pou oun hē kauchēsis exekleisthē dia poiou nomou tōn ergōn ouchi alla dia nomou pisteōs
verses.literal: Where then, is boasting It is excluded On what principle On that of works No but on that of faith
verses.literalPt: Onde está, logo, a jactância? Ficou excluída. Por que lei? Pela das obras? Não; mas pela lei da fé.

verses.original: λογιζόμεθα γὰρ δικαιοῦσθαι πίστει ἄνθρωπον χωρὶς ἔργων νόμου
verses.transliteration: logizometha gar dikaiousthai pistei anthrōpon chōris ergōn nomou
verses.literal: For we maintain that a man is justified by faith apart from works of the law
verses.literalPt: Concluímos, pois, que o homem é justificado pela fé, sem obras da lei.

verses.original: Ἢ Ἰουδαίων ὁ Θεὸς μόνον οὐχὶ καὶ ἐθνῶν ναὶ καὶ ἐθνῶν
verses.transliteration: Ē Ioudaiōn ho Theos monon ouchi kai ethnōn nai kai ethnōn
verses.literal: Is God the God of Jews only Is He not the God of Gentiles too Yes of Gentiles too
verses.literalPt: Porventura, Deus só o é dos judeus? Não o é também dos gentios? Sim, ele o é também dos gentios,

verses.original: εἴπερ εἷς ὁ Θεός ὃς δικαιώσει περιτομὴν ἐκ πίστεως καὶ ἀκροβυστίαν διὰ τῆς πίστεως
verses.transliteration: eiper heis ho Theos hos dikaiōsei peritomēn ek pisteōs kai akrobystian dia tēs pisteōs
verses.literal: since there is only one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith
verses.literalPt: se é que realmente Deus é um, o qual, pela fé, justificará os circuncisos e, pela mesma fé, justificará os incircuncisos.

verses.original: Νόμον οὖν καταργοῦμεν διὰ τῆς πίστεως μὴ γένοιτο ἀλλὰ νόμον ἱστάνομεν
verses.transliteration: Nomon oun katargoumen dia tēs pisteōs mē genoito alla nomon histanomen
verses.literal: Do we, then, nullify the law by this faith Certainly not Instead we uphold the law
verses.literalPt: Anulamos, pois, a Lei pela fé? De modo nenhum! Antes, estabelecemos a Lei.
